# hi120ki

> Security engineering documentation and technical articles about AI security, cloud security, GitHub security, penetration testing, and web performance.

The canonical links below point to the English site. Japanese translations are available from the optional Japanese site link.

## Documentation

- [AI Security](https://hi120ki.github.io/docs/ai-security/intro/): Guidance for securing AI systems, agents, credentials, and MCP integrations.
- [Cloud Security](https://hi120ki.github.io/docs/cloud-security/intro/): Notes on cloud security architecture and identity federation.
- [GitHub Security](https://hi120ki.github.io/docs/github-security/intro/): Security controls and practices for GitHub organizations and applications.
- [Penetration Testing](https://hi120ki.github.io/docs/pentest/intro/): Practical penetration-testing techniques, tools, and resources.
- [Web Performance](https://hi120ki.github.io/docs/web-performance/intro/): Monitoring, analysis, and performance-tuning guidance for web services.

## 2026 Blog Posts

- [Designing and Operating an Agent Kill Switch](https://hi120ki.github.io/blog/posts/20260809/): How to design, trigger, and operate kill switches for AI agents without treating them as a security silver bullet.
- [AI Security Action Items for the Second Half of 2026](https://hi120ki.github.io/blog/posts/20260701/): Prioritized actions for agent identity, authorization, tool permissions, sandboxing, and monitoring.
- [4 Insights from My First Year as an AI Security Engineer](https://hi120ki.github.io/blog/posts/20260524/): Lessons about AI security engineering, agent architecture, standards, and risk management.
- [How Secure Are Claude Managed Agents?](https://hi120ki.github.io/blog/posts/20260413/): A security review of Claude Managed Agents and its hosted agent infrastructure.
- [Action Items for Agent Platform Security](https://hi120ki.github.io/blog/posts/20260223/): Concrete controls for sandboxing, networks, credentials, permissions, and auditability on agent platforms.
- [AI Security Challenges in 2026](https://hi120ki.github.io/blog/posts/20260103/): Industry-wide AI security challenges and practical action items for 2026.
